row.evidence: FortiOS docs: "With SCIM servers, FortiGate can communicate with an Identity Provider (IdP) using the SCIM 2.0 protocol, which facilitates the automatic provisioning of users and groups on FortiGate"; Fortinet publishes no prices, buying is through a sales contact form.
row.notes: Quote-only: Fortinet publishes no price list (how-to-buy redirects to a Contact Us form), so SCIM can only be bought through sales or partners. Row researched on FortiGate/FortiOS 8.0, the main admin product: FortiGate runs a SCIM 2.0 server (HTTPS port 44559 by default) that receives users and groups from an IdP or FortiAuthenticator for SAML firewall/VPN authentication; it is a FortiOS feature, not a separate add-on. Other Fortinet products with their own SCIM endpoints (not split into rows): FortiAuthenticator, FortiIdentity Cloud, FortiSAT, FortiPhish, FortiPAM and FortiClient EMS/FortiEndpoint. Okta lists only a RADIUS MFA integration and a password-vaulting (SWA) FortiCloud app; Entra has an SSO-only FortiGate SSL VPN gallery app, and FortiOS docs mention Azure as a SCIM client.

plans.name: FortiGate (hardware/VM, via sales or partners)
plans.notes: No public tiers; FortiGate is sold per appliance/VM with FortiGuard subscriptions.

auth.token_source: CLI: execute gen-token <cert|key> <name> <algorithm> <expire>, verified via config user scim (auth-method token); basic auth also supported

roles.how: SCIM groups are referenced in FortiGate user groups / firewall policies (group-type scim) for access decisions; no role attribute documented.

limitations.text: Provisioned users and groups are used for SAML firewall/VPN/proxy authentication; FortiGate admin accounts are not provisioned this way.
Expired bearer tokens must be regenerated manually on FortiGate and copied to the SCIM client.
Full FortiOS REST API reference is on the Fortinet KYC Network (FKYC), which requires an account; endpoints not recorded.

okta.notes: OIN search for "fortinet" returns only "Fortinet Fortigate (RADIUS)" MFA support; a separate Forticloud OIN app has only SWA checked in page markup (password vaulting), so no SAML/SCIM app for FortiGate.

entra.notes: Gallery app is SSO-only (FortiGate SSL VPN; also FortiSASE and FortiWeb tutorials). FortiOS docs name Azure as a SCIM client using a FortiGate-generated secret token, i.e. provisioning via a generic non-gallery SCIM app.

fallbacks.other_sync: FortiAuthenticator can act as the SCIM client that pushes users and groups to FortiGate; LDAP/RADIUS remote servers are also supported.
